            for q, r in recs.items():
                K, D = cams[q]
                x, y, yaw = camera_pose(r)
                Rm = geo.camera_rotation(yaw, math.radians(pitch.get(q, 11.5)), 0.0)
                for det in r.get("detections", []):
                    p = np.asarray(det["position"], float)
                    k = int(np.argmin(np.hypot(*(boxes - p).T)))
                    if np.hypot(*(boxes[k] - p)) > 0.3:
                        continue
                    u = (boxes[k] - [x, y]) / np.linalg.norm(boxes[k] - [x, y])
                    face = boxes[k] - APOTHEM_M * u
                    pc = Rm @ (np.array([face[0], face[1], MARKER_CENTRE_M]) - [x, y, CAMERA_HEIGHT_M])
                    bx, by, bw, bh = det["bbox"]
                    obs = cv2.undistortPoints(np.array([[[bx + bw / 2, by + bh / 2]]], np.float64), K, D).reshape(2)
                    out[(layout, q)][0].append(math.degrees(math.atan(obs[1]) - math.atan(pc[1] / pc[2])))
                    out[(layout, q)][1].append(math.degrees(math.atan(obs[0]) - math.atan(pc[0] / pc[2])))
    return out


def calibration(runs, pitch, scope="other-layouts", neighbours=2):
    """(layout, robot) -> (pitch [deg], yaw offset [deg]) of each camera, from the marker detections.
    scope "other-layouts": fitted on all the other layouts (the camera mounting is the same throughout).
    scope "neighbours": fitted on the `neighbours` layouts captured just before and just after (capture
    order = order of the run folders), not on the layout itself: for a campaign in which the cameras were
    moved now and then. scope "same-run": fitted on the layout itself (the camera calibrated in the
    session it is used in; the detections only set the camera angles, never the boxes)."""
    off = angle_offsets(runs, pitch)
    order = [layout for _, layout, *_ in runs]
    cal = {}
    for (layout, q) in off:
        if scope == "same-run":
            use = {layout}
        elif scope == "neighbours":
            k = order.index(layout)
            use = set(order[max(0, k - neighbours):k] + order[k + 1:k + 1 + neighbours])
        else:
            use = set(order) - {layout}
        dv = [v for (l2, q2), (vs, _) in off.items() if q2 == q and l2 in use for v in vs]
        du = [v for (l2, q2), (_, us) in off.items() if q2 == q and l2 in use for v in us]
        if dv:
            cal[(layout, q)] = (pitch.get(q, 11.5) - float(np.median(dv)), float(np.median(du)))
    return cal


MARKER_SIDE_M = 0.077                   # ArUco marker side


def true_markers(boxes, pose, pitch, cam, size, mask):
    """The marker a perfect detector would find on each true box in one frame: the centre of the face that looks
    at the camera (the box centre moved by the apothem towards the camera, at the marker height), projected with
    the camera pose, pitch and lens. A marker is kept if it falls inside the image, on the segmentation mask
    (the box is not hidden by a dark object) and is not behind another box. Returns (box index, full-size
    rectangle (u0, v0, u1, v1)), square, of the marker's apparent size."""
    K, D = cam
    x, y = pose[0], pose[1]
    out = []
    for k, b in enumerate(boxes):
        d = np.hypot(b[0] - x, b[1] - y)
        if d < 1e-6:
            continue
        u = (b - [x, y]) / d
        face = b - APOTHEM_M * u
        hidden = False
        for j, o in enumerate(boxes):              # another box closer to the camera, across the line of sight
            if j == k:
                continue
            t = float(np.dot(o - [x, y], u))
            across = abs(u[0] * (o[1] - y) - u[1] * (o[0] - x))
            if 0 < t < d - APOTHEM_M and across < 0.8 * BOX_SIDE_M / math.sqrt(3):
                hidden = True
        if hidden:
            continue
        uv, ok = geo.project(np.array([[face[0], face[1], MARKER_CENTRE_M]]), pose, pitch, 0.0, CAMERA_HEIGHT_M,
                             K, D, size)
        if not ok[0]:
            continue
        uc, vc = uv[0]
        if mask is not None:
            mh, mw = mask.shape[:2]
            if mask[min(int(vc * mh / size[1]), mh - 1), min(int(uc * mw / size[0]), mw - 1)] < 128:
                continue
        half = 0.5 * K[0, 0] * MARKER_SIDE_M / max(d - APOTHEM_M, 0.1)
        out.append((k, (uc - half, vc - half, uc + half, vc + half)))
    return out


def build_scene(run_dir, layout, boxes, recs, cams, scale, quality, pitch, cal=None, seg=None, cache=None,
                overlays=None, cutout=False, instances=False, marker_channel=False, oracle_markers=False):
    """One scene (the frames `recs` of the robots at one stop) in the format of bevnet/data.py: the images
    (frames, masks, cut-outs or masks + marker channel), the camera poses relative to the centre of the robots,
    the pitch (calibrated with `cal`), each camera's matrix and distortion, and the true boxes. With `seg`
    the frames are segmented (masks read from / written to `cache`)."""
    robots = sorted(recs)
    poses = np.array([camera_pose(recs[q]) for q in robots], np.float64)
    pitch_deg = [pitch.get(q, 11.5) for q in robots]
    if cal:
        for n, q in enumerate(robots):
            if (layout, q) in cal:
                pitch_deg[n] = cal[(layout, q)][0]
                poses[n, 2] += math.radians(cal[(layout, q)][1])
    world = poses.copy()                                    # camera poses in the OptiTrack frame
    centre = poses[:, :2].mean(0)
    poses[:, :2] -= centre
    jpgs, Ks, Ds = [], [], []
    for n, q in enumerate(robots):
        img = cv2.imread(os.path.join(run_dir, recs[q]["image"].replace("\\", "/")))
        if img is None:
            return None
        H, W = img.shape[:2]
        w, h = int(round(1280 * scale)), int(round(720 * scale))
        if seg is not None:                                 # boxes only
            key = os.path.join(cache, os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(run_dir)),
                               os.path.basename(recs[q]["image"].replace("\\", "/"))[:-4] + ".png")
            key_ids = key[:-4] + "_ids.png"                 # one label per box (--instances)
            mask = cv2.imread(key, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) if os.path.exists(key) else None
            labels = cv2.imread(key_ids, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) if os.path.exists(key_ids) else None
            if mask is None or (instances and labels is None):
                mask, rects, labels = seg(img)
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(key), exist_ok=True)
                cv2.imwrite(key, mask)
                cv2.imwrite(key_ids, labels)
                if overlays is not None and len(overlays) < 16:
                    from bevnet.segment import overlay
                    overlays.append(cv2.resize(overlay(img, mask, rects, labels if instances else None),
                                               (640, 360)))
            if instances:                                   # boxes that touch in the image stay apart
                from imgsim.render import separate_instances
                small = separate_instances(cv2.resize(labels, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
            else:
                small = (cv2.resize(mask, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA) > 127).astype(np.uint8) * 255
            if cutout:                                      # the frame inside the mask, black elsewhere
                frame = cv2.resize(img, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
                frame[small == 0] = 0
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".jpg", frame, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, quality])
            elif marker_channel:                            # mask, markers, mask (B, G, R), as imgsim
                mk = np.zeros_like(small)
                dets = recs[q].get("detections", [])
                for det in dets:                            # the ArUco markers detected in this frame
                    bx, by, bw, bh = det["bbox"]
                    cv2.rectangle(mk, (int(round(bx * w / W)), int(round(by * h / H))),
                                  (int(round((bx + bw) * w / W)), int(round((by + bh) * h / H))), 255, -1)
                if oracle_markers:                          # plus the visible boxes the detector missed
                    found = {int(np.argmin(np.hypot(*(boxes - np.asarray(dt["position"], float)).T)))
                             for dt in dets if "position" in dt
                             and np.min(np.hypot(*(boxes - np.asarray(dt["position"], float)).T)) <= 0.3}
                    for k, (u0, v0, u1, v1) in true_markers(boxes, world[n], math.radians(pitch_deg[n]), cams[q],
                                                            (W, H), mask):
                        if k not in found:
                            cv2.rectangle(mk, (int(round(u0 * w / W)), int(round(v0 * h / H))),
                                          (int(round(u1 * w / W)), int(round(v1 * h / H))), 255, -1)
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".png", np.dstack([small, mk, small]))
            else:
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".png", small)
        else:
            small = cv2.resize(img, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
            ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".jpg", small, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, quality])
        jpgs.append(buf.tobytes())
        K, D = cams[q]
        K = K.copy()
        K[0] *= w / W
        K[1] *= h / H
        Ks.append(K.tolist())
        Ds.append(D.tolist())
    rnd = int(recs[robots[0]]["round"])
    return dict(run=f"{layout}_r{rnd}", family="real", boxes=(boxes - centre).astype(np.float32),
                poses=poses.astype(np.float32), pitch=np.radians(pitch_deg).astype(np.float32),
                roll=np.zeros(len(robots), np.float32), height=CAMERA_HEIGHT_M, camera="real", jpgs=jpgs,
                n_robots=len(robots), n_boxes=len(boxes), robots=robots, K=Ks, D=Ds, centre=centre.tolist())


def check_figure(scenes, out_path, n=4):
    """True box centres (green, at the heights of bevnet/geometry.py) and the grid cells within 15 cm of them (red dots)."""
    cells = geo.cell_centres()
    tiles = []
    for s in scenes[:n]:
        row = []
        for k, jpg in enumerate(s["jpgs"]):
            img = cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(jpg, np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
            img = cv2.resize(img, None, fx=2, fy=2, interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
            K, D = np.array(s["K"][k]), np.array(s["D"][k])
            size = (img.shape[1] // 2, img.shape[0] // 2)
            for b in s["boxes"]:
                near = np.hypot(cells[..., 0] - b[0], cells[..., 1] - b[1]) < 0.15
                P = np.concatenate([cells[near], np.full((near.sum(), 1), MARKER_CENTRE_M)], -1)
                uv, ok = geo.project(P, s["poses"][k], float(s["pitch"][k]), 0.0, s["height"], K, D, size)
                for (u, v), o in zip(uv, ok):
                    if o:
                        cv2.circle(img, (int(2 * u), int(2 * v)), 1, (0, 0, 255), -1)
                for hgt in geo.HEIGHTS_M:
                    uv, ok = geo.project(np.array([[b[0], b[1], hgt]]), s["poses"][k], float(s["pitch"][k]), 0.0,
                                         s["height"], K, D, size)
                    if ok[0]:
                        cv2.circle(img, (int(2 * uv[0, 0]), int(2 * uv[0, 1])), 4, (0, 220, 0), -1)
            cv2.putText(img, f"{s['run']} {s['robots'][k]}", (8, 22), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.6, (0, 255, 255), 2)
            row.append(img)
        tiles.append(np.hstack(row))
    cv2.imwrite(out_path, np.vstack(tiles))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--runs", nargs="+", default=["data/survey_rounds/*"])
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="data/bev_real/")
    ap.add_argument("--readings", default="0", help="comma list of readings (0-4): one set each")
    ap.add_argument("--best-run-per-layout", action="store_true",
                    help="several runs of one layout (repeated captures, data/survey_v2): keep one per layout, "
                         "the complete run whose folder name ends in F, otherwise the latest complete one")
    ap.add_argument("--scale", type=float, default=0.2)
    ap.add_argument("--jpeg-quality", type=int, default=92)
    ap.add_argument("--pitch", default=None, help="per robot pitch in degrees, e.g. P0=11,P1=12,P3=11,P5=22")
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="write fig_REAL-0.png with the true boxes drawn in")
    ap.add_argument("--masks", action="store_true", help="boxes only: segment every frame (bevnet/segment.py)")
    ap.add_argument("--instances", action="store_true",
                    help="with --masks: a 1-pixel black line where two segmented boxes touch (as imgsim "
                         "instance_borders); needs the per-box labels, so frames cached without them are "
                         "segmented again")
    ap.add_argument("--marker-channel", action="store_true",
                    help="with --masks: second image channel = the ArUco markers detected in the frame (filled "
                         "rectangles), as imgsim marker_channel")
    ap.add_argument("--oracle-markers", action="store_true",
                    help="with --marker-channel: the detected markers plus, for every visible box the detector "
                         "missed in that frame, the marker a perfect detector would find (true_markers): what the "
                         "network does when no visible marker is missed")
    ap.add_argument("--cutout", action="store_true",
                    help="boxes only, as seen: the frame inside the segmentation mask, black elsewhere")
    ap.add_argument("--mask-cache", default=None,
                    help="folder of the segmentation masks (default <out>/cache; reuse the one of a --masks run)")
    ap.add_argument("--seg-device", default="auto", help="auto | mps | cuda | cpu")
    ap.add_argument("--seg-threshold", type=float, default=0.30, help="detector box threshold")
    ap.add_argument("--prompt", default="a white box.",
                    help="text prompt of the open-vocabulary detector (bevnet/segment.py); a new prompt needs its "
                         "own --mask-cache")
    ap.add_argument("--seg-max-area", type=float, default=0.70,
                    help="largest detector rectangle kept, as a share of the frame (near boxes fill much of it)")
    ap.add_argument("--calibrate", action="store_true",
                    help="pitch and yaw offset per robot from the stored detections, leave one layout out")
    ap.add_argument("--calibrate-scope", choices=["other-layouts", "neighbours", "same-run"],
                    default="other-layouts",
                    help="which detections calibrate the camera of a layout (see calibration()): the other "
                         "layouts, the 2 layouts captured before and after, or the layout itself")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    pitch = dict(PITCH_DEG)
    if a.pitch:
        pitch.update({k: float(v) for k, v in (p.split("=") for p in a.pitch.split(","))})
    run_dirs = sorted({d for p in a.runs for d in glob.glob(p) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(d, "raw"))})
    if a.best_run_per_layout:
        run_dirs = best_runs(run_dirs)
        print(f"  {len(run_dirs)} layouts: " + " ".join(os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(d)) for d in run_dirs),
              flush=True)
    runs = [(d, *load_run(d)) for d in run_dirs]
    cal = calibration(runs, pitch, a.calibrate_scope) if a.calibrate else None
    seg, overlays, cache = None, [], a.mask_cache or os.path.join(a.out, "cache")
    if a.masks or a.cutout:
        from bevnet.segment import BoxSegmenter
        seg = BoxSegmenter(device=a.seg_device, text=a.prompt, box_threshold=a.seg_threshold,
                           max_area=a.seg_max_area, half=False)
    if cal:
        for q in sorted({q for _, q in cal}):
            v = np.array([cal[k] for k in cal if k[1] == q])
            print(f"  {q}: pitch {v[:, 0].mean():.2f} deg (assumed {pitch.get(q, 11.5):.1f}), "
                  f"yaw offset {v[:, 1].mean():+.2f} deg, over the {len(v)} leave-one-out fits")
    for k in [int(v) for v in a.readings.split(",")]:
        scenes = []
        for d, layout, boxes, frames, cams in runs:
            for (rnd, reading, off), recs in sorted(frames.items()):
                if reading == k:
                    s = build_scene(d, layout, boxes, recs, cams, a.scale, a.jpeg_quality, pitch, cal, seg, cache,
                                    overlays, a.cutout, a.instances, a.marker_channel,
                                    a.oracle_markers)
                    if s is not None:
                        s["round"] = rnd
                        if off:                     # the cameras turned by `off` degrees at every stop
                            s["run"] += f"_y{off:+d}"
                        scenes.append(s)
        name = f"real_k{k}"
        out = os.path.join(a.out, name)
        os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
        for old in glob.glob(os.path.join(out, "shard_*.pkl")):
            os.replace(old, old + ".old")
        from bevnet.data import SHARD
        for j, start in enumerate(range(0, len(scenes), SHARD)):   # the loader reads SHARD scenes per file
            with open(os.path.join(out, f"shard_{j:04d}.pkl"), "wb") as f:
                pickle.dump(scenes[start:start + SHARD], f, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)
        K0 = scenes[0]["K"][0]
        with open(os.path.join(out, "meta.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(dict(set=name, scenario="real", level=f"k{k}", scenes=len(scenes), camera="real", K=K0,
                           marker_channel=bool(a.marker_channel and a.masks),
                           marker_source="detections + missed visible" if a.oracle_markers else "detections",
                           prompt=a.prompt if (a.masks or a.cutout) else None,
                           calibrate_scope=a.calibrate_scope if a.calibrate else None,
                           D=scenes[0]["D"][0], size=[int(round(1280 * a.scale)), int(round(720 * a.scale))],
                           scale=a.scale, pitch_deg=pitch, runs=[os.path.basename(r[0]) for r in runs],
                           calibration={f"{l}/{q}": v for (l, q), v in cal.items()} if cal else None), f, indent=2)
        print(f"  {name}: {len(scenes)} scenes, {sum(s['n_robots'] for s in scenes)} images -> {out}", flush=True)
        if overlays and k == int(a.readings.split(",")[0]):
            rows = [np.hstack(overlays[r:r + 4]) for r in range(0, len(overlays) - len(overlays) % 4, 4)]
            if rows:
                cv2.imwrite(os.path.join(a.out, "fig_REAL-masks.png"), np.vstack(rows))
                print(f"  mask figure: {os.path.join(a.out, 'fig_REAL-masks.png')}")
        if a.check and k == int(a.readings.split(",")[0]):
            check_figure(scenes, os.path.join(a.out, "fig_REAL-0.png"))
            print(f"  check figure: {os.path.join(a.out, 'fig_REAL-0.png')}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

==> ./bevnet/model.py <==
"""Image-based collaborative network: images + camera poses -> a map of the boxes on the floor.

  1. image encoder (every robot, the same weights): a small CNN, or an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18
     (--encoder resnet18), features at 1/4 of the image size
  2. lift to the floor (every robot): the features are read at the pixels where each floor cell, lifted to the
     heights of bevnet/geometry.py, falls in the image (grid_sample with the grids of the data loader), joined
     with the direction and distance of the cell from the camera, and turned by a 1 x 1 network into the
     robot's MESSAGE: --message channels per floor cell it sees (zero elsewhere)
  3. fusion (the team): per cell, the mean and the maximum of the messages of the robots that see it, and how
     many see it
  4. floor decoder: a small U-Net on the 80 x 80 grid -> the probability that a box centre lies in each cell
     and the sub-cell offset of that centre; the boxes are the local maxima above a threshold chosen on the
     validation set (bevnet/geometry.decode)
Trained with the focal loss of CenterNet on a Gaussian around each true box and an L1 loss on the offsets.
The message is what a robot would send to the others: its size is message x the cells it sees.
"""

import math

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv(cin, cout, stride=1, dilation=1):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, 3, stride, padding=dilation, dilation=dilation, bias=False),
                         nn.BatchNorm2d(cout), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))


class ImageEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(conv(3, 32, 2), conv(32, 32), conv(32, 64, 2), conv(64, 64),
                                 conv(64, channels, 1, 2), conv(channels, channels, 1, 4))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ResNetEncoder(nn.Module):
    """ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 (torchvision): layer1 (1/4), layer2 (1/8) and layer3 (1/16) brought to
    1/4 of the image and summed, so the features sit where the small encoder's do. Features learned on
    real photographs carry over to real frames better than ones learned on rendered images only."""

    def __init__(self, channels=64, pretrained=True):
        super().__init__()
        from torchvision.models import ResNet18_Weights, resnet18
        net = resnet18(weights=ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 if pretrained else None)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(net.conv1, net.bn1, net.relu, net.maxpool)
        self.layer1, self.layer2, self.layer3 = net.layer1, net.layer2, net.layer3
        self.p1, self.p2, self.p3 = nn.Conv2d(64, channels, 1), nn.Conv2d(128, channels, 1), nn.Conv2d(256, channels, 1)
        self.out = conv(channels, channels)
        self.register_buffer("mean", torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(1, 3, 1, 1))
        self.register_buffer("std", torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(1, 3, 1, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = (x - self.mean) / self.std
        c1 = self.layer1(self.stem(x))
        c2 = self.layer2(c1)
        c3 = self.layer3(c2)
        size = c1.shape[-2:]
        f = self.p1(c1) + F.interpolate(self.p2(c2), size=size, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False) + \
            F.interpolate(self.p3(c3), size=size, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
        return self.out(f)


class FloorDecoder(nn.Module):
    """U-Net on the floor grid: c channels at 80 x 80, 2c at 40 x 40, 4c at 20 x 20 (dilated)."""

    def __init__(self, cin, c=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.e1 = nn.Sequential(conv(cin, c), conv(c, c))
        self.e2 = nn.Sequential(conv(c, 2 * c, 2), conv(2 * c, 2 * c))
        self.e3 = nn.Sequential(conv(2 * c, 4 * c, 2), conv(4 * c, 4 * c, 1, 2))
        self.u2 = conv(6 * c, 2 * c)
        self.u1 = conv(3 * c, c)
        self.heat = nn.Conv2d(c, 1, 1)
        self.off = nn.Conv2d(c, 2, 1)
        nn.init.constant_(self.heat.bias, -math.log(9.0))       # start at p = 0.1 (CenterNet)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.e1(x)
        e2 = self.e2(e1)
        e3 = self.e3(e2)
        d2 = self.u2(torch.cat([F.interpolate(e3, size=e2.shape[-2:], mode="bilinear", align_corners=False), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.u1(torch.cat([F.interpolate(d2, size=e1.shape[-2:], mode="bilinear", align_corners=False), e1], 1))
        return self.heat(d1), self.off(d1)


class BevNet(nn.Module):
    """The image network: the same encoder on every robot's image, the features lifted to the floor grid at
    `heights` heights and turned into a message of `message` channels per cell, the messages of the robots of
    a scene fused cell by cell (mean, maximum, number of robots that see the cell), and a decoder on the floor
    that returns the map of box centres and the offsets inside the cells."""

    def __init__(self, channels=64, message=16, heights=3, encoder="small", pretrained=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = ResNetEncoder(channels, pretrained) if encoder == "resnet18" else ImageEncoder(channels)
        self.lift = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(channels * heights + 4, channels, 1), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
                                  nn.Conv2d(channels, message, 1))
        self.decoder = FloorDecoder(2 * message + 1, channels // 2)

    def messages(self, images, grids, valid, view):
        """Per robot image: (message (N, M, G, G), cells it sees (N, 1, G, G))."""
        f = self.encoder(images)
        samples = [F.grid_sample(f, grids[:, k], mode="bilinear", padding_mode="zeros", align_corners=False)
                   * valid[:, k, None].float() for k in range(grids.shape[1])]
        seen = valid.any(1, keepdim=True).float()
        x = torch.cat(samples + [view * seen, seen], 1)
        return self.lift(x) * seen, seen

    def forward(self, images, grids, valid, view, scene, n_scenes):
        m, seen = self.messages(images, grids, valid, view)
        S, (_, M, G, _) = n_scenes, m.shape
        total = m.new_zeros(S, M, G, G).index_add_(0, scene, m)
        count = seen.new_zeros(S, 1, G, G).index_add_(0, scene, seen)
        mean = total / count.clamp(min=1.0)
        big = torch.where(seen.bool(), m, torch.full_like(m, -1e4))
        mx = torch.stack([big[scene == s].max(0).values for s in range(S)])
        mx = torch.where(count > 0, mx, torch.zeros_like(mx))
        return self.decoder(torch.cat([mean.float(), mx.float(), count.float() / 4.0], 1))


def losses(heat_logits, off, target_heat, target_off, mask):
    """CenterNet focal loss on the box-centre map and L1 on the offsets of the box cells."""
    p = torch.sigmoid(heat_logits[:, 0]).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
    pos = target_heat.eq(1).float()
    pos_loss = -torch.log(p) * (1 - p) ** 2 * pos
    neg_loss = -torch.log(1 - p) * p ** 2 * (1 - target_heat) ** 4 * (1 - pos)
    n = pos.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
    focal = (pos_loss.sum() + neg_loss.sum()) / n
    l1 = ((off - target_off).abs() * mask[:, None]).sum() / (2 * mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0))
    return focal, l1

==> ./bevnet/geometry.py <==
"""Floor grid and camera projection of the image-based network (NumPy, run in the data loader).

The network reasons on a grid of the floor in the world frame: GRID_HALF_M around the arena centre, CELL_M per
cell (80 x 80 cells of 5 cm). For every image, the centre of every cell is lifted to a few heights on the boxes
(HEIGHTS_M: near the floor, the marker band, near the top) and projected into the image with the known camera
pose (OptiTrack, or GPS / odometry on another platform), the downward pitch and the real lens model; the
network then reads its image features at those pixels (torch grid_sample). Nothing is measured from the image
here: the geometry only says where on the floor each pixel can come from.
"""

import math

import numpy as np

GRID_HALF_M = 2.0
CELL_M = 0.05
HEIGHTS_M = (0.05, 0.15, 0.25)          # on the 30 cm boxes: near the floor, the marker, near the top
MAX_RANGE_M = 3.5                      # beyond this a cell is outside the camera's useful range


def grid_size():
    return int(round(2 * GRID_HALF_M / CELL_M))


def cell_centres():
    """(G, G, 2) world (x, y) of the cell centres; row i <-> y, column j <-> x."""
    G = grid_size()
    c = -GRID_HALF_M + CELL_M * (np.arange(G) + 0.5)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(c, c)
    return np.stack([X, Y], -1)


def camera_rotation(yaw, pitch, roll):
    """World -> camera rotation (rows: camera x right, y down, z forward), as imgsim/render.py."""
    f = np.array([math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), -math.sin(pitch)])
    r = np.array([math.sin(yaw), -math.cos(yaw), 0.0])
    d = np.cross(f, r)
    r2 = math.cos(roll) * r + math.sin(roll) * d
    d2 = -math.sin(roll) * r + math.cos(roll) * d
    return np.stack([r2, d2, f])


def project(P, pose, pitch, roll, height, K, D, size):
    """World points (..., 3) -> pixels (..., 2) and a validity mask (in front, inside the image, within the lens
    model's range). OpenCV's radial-tangential distortion (k1, k2, p1, p2, k3)."""
    x, y, yaw = pose
    R = camera_rotation(yaw, pitch, roll)
    pc = (np.asarray(P, np.float64) - np.array([x, y, height])) @ R.T
    z = pc[..., 2]
    zs = np.where(z > 1e-3, z, 1e-3)
    xn, yn = pc[..., 0] / zs, pc[..., 1] / zs
    k1, k2, p1, p2, k3 = (list(np.asarray(D, float).reshape(-1)) + [0.0] * 5)[:5]
    r2 = xn * xn + yn * yn
    radial = 1 + k1 * r2 + k2 * r2 ** 2 + k3 * r2 ** 3
    xd = xn * radial + 2 * p1 * xn * yn + p2 * (r2 + 2 * xn * xn)
    yd = yn * radial + p1 * (r2 + 2 * yn * yn) + 2 * p2 * xn * yn
    u = K[0, 0] * xd + K[0, 2]
    v = K[1, 1] * yd + K[1, 2]
    W, H = size
    r2_max = ((W / 2) / K[0, 0]) ** 2 + ((H / 2) / K[1, 1]) ** 2       # image corner, undistorted
    valid = (z > 0.05) & (r2 < 1.3 * r2_max) & (u >= 0) & (u <= W - 1) & (v >= 0) & (v <= H - 1)
    return np.stack([u, v], -1), valid


def sampling_grid(pose, pitch, roll, height, K, D, size, cells=None):
    """For one image: normalised grid_sample coordinates (len(HEIGHTS_M), G, G, 2) in [-1, 1]
    (align_corners=False), their validity (len(HEIGHTS_M), G, G), and per-cell view features (3, G, G): the
    unit direction from the camera to the cell and its distance / MAX_RANGE_M."""
    cells = cell_centres() if cells is None else cells
    W, H = size
    grids, valid = [], []
    dist = np.hypot(cells[..., 0] - pose[0], cells[..., 1] - pose[1])
    for h in HEIGHTS_M:
        P = np.concatenate([cells, np.full(cells.shape[:2] + (1,), h)], -1)
        uv, ok = project(P, pose, pitch, roll, height, K, D, size)
        ok &= dist <= MAX_RANGE_M
        g = np.stack([(2 * uv[..., 0] + 1) / W - 1, (2 * uv[..., 1] + 1) / H - 1], -1)
        grids.append(np.where(ok[..., None], g, -2.0))
        valid.append(ok)
    d = np.maximum(dist, 1e-6)
    view = np.stack([(cells[..., 0] - pose[0]) / d, (cells[..., 1] - pose[1]) / d, dist / MAX_RANGE_M])
    return np.array(grids, np.float32), np.array(valid, bool), view.astype(np.float32)


def heatmap_targets(boxes, sigma_cells=1.5):
    """Training targets of the boxes (B, 2): a Gaussian per box on the grid (G, G) with 1 at its cell, the
    sub-cell offset (2, G, G) and the mask of the box cells (G, G)."""
    G = grid_size()
    heat = np.zeros((G, G), np.float32)
    off = np.zeros((2, G, G), np.float32)
    mask = np.zeros((G, G), np.float32)
    ii, jj = np.mgrid[0:G, 0:G]
    for bx, by in boxes:
        fj, fi = (bx + GRID_HALF_M) / CELL_M - 0.5, (by + GRID_HALF_M) / CELL_M - 0.5
        j, i = int(round(fj)), int(round(fi))
        if not (0 <= i < G and 0 <= j < G):
            continue
        heat = np.maximum(heat, np.exp(-((ii - i) ** 2 + (jj - j) ** 2) / (2 * sigma_cells ** 2)))
        heat[i, j] = 1.0
        off[:, i, j] = (fj - j, fi - i)
        mask[i, j] = 1.0
    return heat.astype(np.float32), off, mask


def decode(heat, off, threshold, min_dist_m=0.0):
    """Box positions (K, 2) from a probability map (G, G) and its offsets (2, G, G): the local maxima (3 x 3)
    above threshold; with min_dist_m > 0, a maximum closer than that to a stronger one is dropped."""
    G = heat.shape[0]
    pad = np.pad(heat, 1, constant_values=-1)
    neigh = np.max(np.stack([pad[1 + di:G + 1 + di, 1 + dj:G + 1 + dj] for di in (-1, 0, 1) for dj in (-1, 0, 1)]),
                   axis=0)
    ii, jj = np.nonzero((heat >= neigh) & (heat > threshold))
    x = -GRID_HALF_M + CELL_M * (jj + 0.5 + off[0, ii, jj])
    y = -GRID_HALF_M + CELL_M * (ii + 0.5 + off[1, ii, jj])
    if not len(ii):
        return np.zeros((0, 2))
    pts = np.stack([x, y], -1)
    if min_dist_m > 0:
        keep = []
        for k in np.argsort(-heat[ii, jj]):
            if all(np.hypot(*(pts[k] - pts[q])) >= min_dist_m for q in keep):
                keep.append(k)
        pts = pts[sorted(keep)]
    return pts

==> ./bevnet/train.py <==
"""Trains and tests the image-based network (bevnet/model.py) on the sets of bevnet/data.py.

The epoch and the detection threshold are chosen on the validation set (the share of correct scenes: right
number of boxes and every box within 15 cm, the metric of MHT and the GNN, counted against the boxes some robot
can see: sets rendered as masks record which ones; see bevnet/data.py); no test scene is used for anything
but the test. Outputs in --out/<variant>/: model.pt, train_log.csv, variant.json, test_scenes.csv (one row per
test scene: n_true, n_est, dn, n_matched, rmse, correct, run, set) and summary.csv (per test set: correct, too
few, too many, misplaced boxes, RMSE). The scenes have the run ids of sim/plan.py, so bevnet/compare.py can put
them next to MHT and the GNN on the same scenes.

Runs on a CUDA GPU when there is one (--device auto), otherwise on the CPU (slow: start with --max-train).

    python -m bevnet.train --train data/bev/train --val data/bev/val --tests "data/bev/G0_*" "data/bev/E3_*" "data/bev/S1_*"
    python -m bevnet.train ... --eval-only           # test the saved model again
    python -m bevnet.train --eval-only --out results/bev_rand/ --tests "data/bev_unseen/*" --results-name unseen
"""

import argparse
import contextlib
import csv
import glob
import json
import os
import time

import numpy as np
import torch

from bevnet import geometry as geo
from bevnet.data import BevDataset, ShardSampler, collate
from bevnet.model import BevNet, losses
from pipeline.evaluate_runs import MATCH_CUTOFF_M, scene_metrics

THRESHOLDS = np.round(np.arange(0.20, 0.751, 0.05), 2)


def expand(patterns):
    return sorted({d for p in patterns for d in (glob.glob(p) if any(c in p for c in "*?[") else [p])
                   if os.path.isdir(d)})


def loader(ds, batch, shuffle, workers, seed=0, persistent=True):
    return torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=batch, sampler=ShardSampler(ds, seed) if shuffle else None,
                                       num_workers=workers,
                                       collate_fn=collate, persistent_workers=persistent and workers > 0,
                                       pin_memory=torch.cuda.is_available())


def to(batch, device):
    return {k: (v.to(device, non_blocking=True) if torch.is_tensor(v) else v) for k, v in batch.items()}


def predict_iter(model, dl, device):
    """Per scene: (probability map (G, G), offsets (2, G, G), true boxes, run, set, seen boxes (B,) bool)."""
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for b in dl:
            b = to(b, device)
            heat, off = model(b["images"], b["grids"], b["valid"], b["view"], b["scene"], b["n_scenes"])
            heat = torch.sigmoid(heat[:, 0]).float().cpu().numpy()
            off = off.float().cpu().numpy()
            for k in range(b["n_scenes"]):
                yield heat[k], off[k], b["boxes"][k], b["run"][k], b["set"][k], b["seen"][k]


def predict(model, dl, device):
    return list(predict_iter(model, dl, device))


def score_one(heat, off, boxes, run, set_name, threshold, cutoff=MATCH_CUTOFF_M, min_dist_m=0.0, seen=None):
    """correct: against every box. solvable: every box is seen by some robot. correct_seen: against the seen
    boxes only (what the images allow; the same as correct on a solvable scene)."""
    est = geo.decode(heat, off, threshold, min_dist_m)
    boxes = np.asarray(boxes)
    m = scene_metrics(list(est), list(boxes), cutoff, 2.0)
    m["correct"] = int(m["dn"] == 0 and m["n_matched"] == m["n_true"])
    seen = np.ones(len(boxes), bool) if seen is None else np.asarray(seen, bool)
    m["solvable"] = int(seen.all())
    if m["solvable"]:
        m["correct_seen"] = m["correct"]
    else:
        ms = scene_metrics(list(est), list(boxes[seen]), cutoff, 2.0)
        m["correct_seen"] = int(ms["dn"] == 0 and ms["n_matched"] == ms["n_true"])
    return dict(m, run=run, set=set_name)


def score(preds, threshold, cutoff=MATCH_CUTOFF_M):
    return [score_one(h, o, b, r, s, threshold, cutoff, seen=v) for h, o, b, r, s, v in preds]


def save_variant(out, a, threshold, best, epoch):
    with open(os.path.join(out, "variant.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(dict(vars(a), eval_only=False, threshold=threshold, best_val_correct_pct=best, best_epoch=epoch),
                  f, indent=2)


def write_csv(path, rows):
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--train", nargs="+", default=["data/bev/train"])
    ap.add_argument("--val", nargs="+", default=["data/bev/val"])
    ap.add_argument("--tests", nargs="*", default=["data/bev/G0_*", "data/bev/E3_*", "data/bev/S1_*"])
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="results/bev/")
    ap.add_argument("--channels", type=int, default=64)
    ap.add_argument("--encoder", choices=["small", "resnet18"], default="small",
                    help="resnet18: ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 (needs torchvision)")
    ap.add_argument("--encoder-lr", type=float, default=0.2, help="learning rate of a pretrained encoder / --lr")
    ap.add_argument("--jitter", type=float, default=0.0, help="colour and brightness jitter of training images")
    ap.add_argument("--pitch-noise", type=float, default=0.0,
                    help="sd [deg] of the error added to the pitch given with each training image")
    ap.add_argument("--yaw-noise", type=float, default=0.0, help="sd [deg] of the error added to the yaw")
    ap.add_argument("--height-noise", type=float, default=0.0, help="sd [m] of the error added to the camera height")
    ap.add_argument("--mask-noise", type=float, default=0.0,
                    help="training on masks: imperfect segmentation (1 = edges, holes, blobs, missed boxes)")
    ap.add_argument("--marker-dropout", type=float, default=0.0,
                    help="sets with a marker channel: missed, dropped and false marker detections in training "
                         "(1 = default amounts, see bevnet/data.noisy_markers)")
    ap.add_argument("--marker-rates", action="store_true",
                    help="with --marker-dropout: each marker missed as often as in the real frames at its distance "
                         "(bevnet/data.marker_keep) instead of with a fixed probability")
    ap.add_argument("--fuse-frames", action="store_true",
                    help="tests: also fuse the sets that are frames of the same stops (real_k0 ... real_k4): the "
                         "box-centre maps of the frames averaged before decoding, one more set 'fused'")
    ap.add_argument("--drop-markers", action="store_true",
                    help="test with the marker channel emptied (what if the marker detection fails)")
    ap.add_argument("--min-visible-px", type=int, default=12,
                    help="a box counts as seen with this many visible pixels in one image (sets rendered as masks)")
    ap.add_argument("--name", default=None, help="variant folder name (default bev_c<channels>_m<message>)")
    ap.add_argument("--message", type=int, default=16, help="channels per floor cell a robot sends to the others")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--patience", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=8, help="scenes per batch")
    ap.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-3)
    ap.add_argument("--weight-decay", type=float, default=1e-4)
    ap.add_argument("--offset-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--max-train", type=int, default=None, help="use only the first N training scenes")
    ap.add_argument("--max-val", type=int, default=2000)
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=4, help="data loader processes")
    ap.add_argument("--device", default="auto", help="auto (cuda if there is one, else cpu) | cuda | cpu | mps")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--eval-only", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--save-maps", type=int, default=0,
                    help="save the box-centre maps of the first N scenes of every test set (maps_<name>.npz)")
    ap.add_argument("--diagnose", action="store_true",
                    help="also print correct %% per test set for other thresholds and peak distances (small sets)")
    ap.add_argument("--results-name", default="", help="test outputs as summary_<name>.csv, test_scenes_<name>.csv")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    torch.multiprocessing.set_sharing_strategy("file_system")     # macOS: few open files allowed per process
    device = torch.device(("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu") if a.device == "auto" else a.device)
    cuda = device.type == "cuda"
    torch.manual_seed(a.seed)
    np.random.seed(a.seed)
    out = os.path.join(a.out, a.name or f"bev_c{a.channels}_m{a.message}")
    if a.eval_only and os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "variant.json")):      # the network of the saved model
        with open(os.path.join(out, "variant.json")) as f:
            saved = json.load(f)
        a.channels, a.message, a.encoder = saved["channels"], saved["message"], saved.get("encoder", "small")
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"device {device}, variant {out}", flush=True)
    model = BevNet(a.channels, a.message, len(geo.HEIGHTS_M), a.encoder, pretrained=not a.eval_only).to(device)
    print(f"{sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,} parameters", flush=True)
    val = BevDataset(expand(a.val), a.max_val)
    val.min_visible_px = a.min_visible_px
    val_dl = loader(val, a.batch, False, a.workers)

    if a.eval_only:
        model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(out, "model.pt"), map_location=device))
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "variant.json")):
            with open(os.path.join(out, "variant.json")) as f:
                threshold = json.load(f)["threshold"]
        else:                                                 # training stopped before it wrote variant.json
            with open(os.path.join(out, "train_log.csv"), newline="") as f:
                rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
            top = max(rows, key=lambda r: float(r["val_correct_pct"]))
            threshold = float(top["threshold"])
            save_variant(out, a, threshold, float(top["val_correct_pct"]), int(top["epoch"]))
            print(f"  variant.json rebuilt from train_log.csv: epoch {top['epoch']}, threshold {threshold:.2f}")
    else:
        train = BevDataset(expand(a.train), a.max_train)
        train.pitch_noise_deg, train.yaw_noise_deg, train.height_noise_m = a.pitch_noise, a.yaw_noise, a.height_noise
        train.mask_noise = a.mask_noise
        train.min_visible_px = a.min_visible_px
        train.marker_dropout = a.marker_dropout
        train.marker_rates = a.marker_rates
        print(f"{len(train)} training scenes, {len(val)} validation scenes", flush=True)
        train_dl = loader(train, a.batch, True, a.workers, a.seed)
        pre = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if n.startswith("encoder.") and a.encoder == "resnet18"
               and not n.startswith(("encoder.p", "encoder.out"))]
        ids = {id(p) for p in pre}
        groups = [dict(params=[p for p in model.parameters() if id(p) not in ids], lr=a.lr)]
        if pre:
            groups.append(dict(params=pre, lr=a.lr * a.encoder_lr))
        opt = torch.optim.AdamW(groups, lr=a.lr, weight_decay=a.weight_decay)
        sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(opt, max_lr=[g["lr"] for g in groups],
                                                    total_steps=a.epochs * len(train_dl),
                                                    pct_start=0.1)
        scaler = (torch.amp.GradScaler("cuda", enabled=cuda) if hasattr(torch.amp, "GradScaler")
                  else torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=cuda))
        best, log, waited, threshold = -1.0, [], 0, 0.5
        try:                                                  # Ctrl+C: stop training, test the best epoch
            for epoch in range(1, a.epochs + 1):
                model.train()
                t0, total, nb = time.time(), 0.0, 0
                for b in train_dl:
                    b = to(b, device)
                    img = b["images"]
                    if a.jitter > 0:                                  # colour, brightness and contrast of each image
                        n = img.shape[0]
                        gain = 1 + a.jitter * (torch.rand(n, 3, 1, 1, device=device) - 0.5)
                        bias = 0.5 * a.jitter * (torch.rand(n, 1, 1, 1, device=device) - 0.5)
                        img = (img * gain + bias).clamp(0, 1)
                    with (torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16) if cuda else contextlib.nullcontext()):
                        heat, off = model(img, b["grids"], b["valid"], b["view"], b["scene"], b["n_scenes"])
                    focal, l1 = losses(heat.float(), off.float(), b["heat"], b["off"], b["mask"])
                    loss = focal + a.offset_weight * l1
                    opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                    scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                    scaler.step(opt)
                    scaler.update()
                    sched.step()
                    total += loss.item()
                    nb += 1
                preds = predict(model, val_dl, device)
                rates = {t: 100 * np.mean([r["correct_seen"] for r in score(preds, t)]) for t in THRESHOLDS}
                t_best = max(rates, key=rates.get)
                log.append(dict(epoch=epoch, loss=round(total / max(nb, 1), 4), val_correct_pct=round(rates[t_best], 2),
                                threshold=float(t_best), seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 1)))
                print(f"  epoch {epoch:3d}: loss {log[-1]['loss']:.4f}  validation correct (seen boxes) {rates[t_best]:5.1f}% "
                      f"(threshold {t_best:.2f})  ({log[-1]['seconds']:.0f} s)", flush=True)
                write_csv(os.path.join(out, "train_log.csv"), log)
                if rates[t_best] > best:
                    best, threshold, waited = rates[t_best], float(t_best), 0
                    torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(out, "model.pt"))
                    save_variant(out, a, threshold, best, epoch)
                else:
                    waited += 1
                    if waited >= a.patience:
                        break
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("  training stopped by the user: the best epoch so far is tested", flush=True)
        model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(out, "model.pt"), map_location=device))
        save_variant(out, a, threshold, best, max(log, key=lambda r: r["val_correct_pct"])["epoch"])
        print(f"kept epoch {max(log, key=lambda r: r['val_correct_pct'])['epoch']} "
              f"(validation correct {best:.1f}%, threshold {threshold:.2f})", flush=True)

    # one data loader over all the test sets: a new loader per set leaks open files on macOS
    dirs = expand(a.tests)
    rows, summary = [], []
    if dirs:
        ds = BevDataset(dirs)
        ds.min_visible_px = a.min_visible_px
        ds.drop_markers = a.drop_markers
        by_set, maps, kept, frames = {}, {}, {}, {}
        for heat, off, boxes, run, set_name, seen in predict_iter(model, loader(ds, a.batch, False, a.workers), device):
            by_set.setdefault(set_name, []).append(score_one(heat, off, boxes, run, set_name, threshold, seen=seen))
            if a.fuse_frames:                                 # the frames of one stop: same run id in every set
                frames.setdefault(run, []).append((heat, off, boxes, seen))
            if a.save_maps and len(maps.setdefault(set_name, [])) < a.save_maps:
                maps[set_name].append((heat.astype(np.float16), off.astype(np.float16), np.asarray(boxes), run,
                                       geo.decode(heat, off, threshold)))
            if a.diagnose:
                kept.setdefault(set_name, []).append((heat, off, boxes))
        if frames:                                            # the maps of the frames of each stop averaged
            by_set["fused"] = [score_one(np.mean([f[0] for f in fs], 0), np.mean([f[1] for f in fs], 0), fs[0][2],
                                         run, "fused", threshold, seen=fs[0][3]) for run, fs in sorted(frames.items())]
        sfx = f"_{a.results_name}" if a.results_name else ""
        for set_name in sorted(by_set):
            r = by_set[set_name]
            rows += r
            summary.append(dict(set=set_name, scenes=len(r),
                                correct_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["correct"] for x in r]), 2),
                                too_few_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["dn"] < 0 for x in r]), 2),
                                too_many_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["dn"] > 0 for x in r]), 2),
                                misplaced_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["dn"] == 0 and not x["correct"] for x in r]), 2),
                                rmse_cm=round(100 * float(np.nanmean([x["rmse"] for x in r])), 2),
                                solvable_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["solvable"] for x in r]), 2),
                                correct_solvable_pct=round(100 * np.mean([x["correct"] for x in r if x["solvable"]]), 2)
                                if any(x["solvable"] for x in r) else float("nan")))
            print(f"  {set_name:20s} correct {summary[-1]['correct_pct']:5.1f}%  too few "
                  f"{summary[-1]['too_few_pct']:5.1f}%  too many {summary[-1]['too_many_pct']:5.1f}%  "
                  f"RMSE {summary[-1]['rmse_cm']:.1f} cm  solvable {summary[-1]['solvable_pct']:5.1f}%  "
                  f"correct on solvable {summary[-1]['correct_solvable_pct']:5.1f}%", flush=True)
        write_csv(os.path.join(out, f"test_scenes{sfx}.csv"), rows)
        write_csv(os.path.join(out, f"summary{sfx}.csv"), summary)
        if maps:
            flat = [(s, *m) for s in sorted(maps) for m in maps[s]]
            np.savez_compressed(os.path.join(out, f"maps{sfx}.npz"), set=np.array([f[0] for f in flat]),
                                heat=np.stack([f[1] for f in flat]), off=np.stack([f[2] for f in flat]),
                                truth=np.array([f[3] for f in flat], dtype=object),
                                run=np.array([f[4] for f in flat]), est=np.array([f[5] for f in flat], dtype=object),
                                threshold=threshold)
            print(f"  maps of {len(flat)} scenes: {os.path.join(out, f'maps{sfx}.npz')}")
        if kept:
            print("  correct % for other thresholds (columns) and minimum peak distances (rows):")
            ths = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 0.951, 0.05), 2)
            for set_name in sorted(kept):
                print(f"  {set_name}: " + " ".join(f"{t:5.2f}" for t in ths))
                for md in (0.0, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25):
                    c = [100 * np.mean([score_one(h, o, b, "", "", t, min_dist_m=md)["correct"]
                                        for h, o, b in kept[set_name]]) for t in ths]
                    print(f"    {md:4.2f} m " + " ".join(f"{v:5.1f}" for v in c), flush=True)
    if rows:
        print(f"written in {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

==> ./bevnet/segment.py <==
"""Box masks of real camera frames: everything but the boxes removed, as in the boxes-only simulation
(imgsim/render.py, Appearance.mask_only).

Two pre-trained models, no training: Grounding DINO (open-vocabulary detector, text prompt "a white box.")
gives the box rectangles, SAM (Segment Anything) turns each rectangle into a pixel mask; the masks are joined.
Rectangles that are too large (walls, desks) or much wider than tall are dropped, and the own gripper at the
bottom of the frame is blanked. The models are downloaded from the Hugging Face hub the first time
(pip install transformers).

    from bevnet.segment import BoxSegmenter
    seg = BoxSegmenter()                  # device auto: mps / cuda / cpu
    mask, rects, labels = seg(bgr_image)  # uint8 0 / 255, same size as the image
    many = seg.many([bgr1, bgr2, ...])    # the same for several frames at once (faster on a GPU)

half=True (CUDA only) runs both models in half precision (autocast): about twice as fast, same masks within a
few pixels.
"""

import os

import cv2
import numpy as np

DETECTOR = "IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny"
SEGMENTER = "facebook/sam-vit-base"
GRIPPER = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "imgsim", "assets", "gripper_mask.png")


class BoxSegmenter:
    """Mask of the boxes in a real frame: Grounding DINO finds the rectangles that match `text`, SAM draws the
    mask of the object in each of them, and the gripper at the bottom of the frame is blanked. Calling it
    returns (mask, rectangles, labels): labels gives every box its own index, for the instance borders."""

    def __init__(self, device="auto", text="a white box.", box_threshold=0.30, text_threshold=0.25,
                 max_area=0.70, max_aspect=2.5, half=False):
        import torch
        from PIL import Image  # noqa: F401  (needed by the processors)
        from transformers import AutoModelForZeroShotObjectDetection, AutoProcessor, SamModel, SamProcessor
        if device == "auto":
            device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else ("mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.torch, self.device = torch, torch.device(device)
        self.half = bool(half) and self.device.type == "cuda"
        self.det_proc = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(DETECTOR)
        self.det = AutoModelForZeroShotObjectDetection.from_pretrained(DETECTOR).to(self.device).eval()
        self.sam_proc = SamProcessor.from_pretrained(SEGMENTER)
        self.sam = SamModel.from_pretrained(SEGMENTER).to(self.device).eval()
        self.text, self.box_threshold, self.text_threshold = text, box_threshold, text_threshold
        self.max_area, self.max_aspect = max_area, max_aspect
        g = cv2.imread(GRIPPER, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        self.gripper = g

    def autocast(self):
        torch = self.torch
        if self.half:
            return torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
        import contextlib
        return contextlib.nullcontext()

    def rectangles(self, pil):
        return self.rectangles_many([pil])[0]

    def rectangles_many(self, pils):
        """Grounding DINO on several images in one batch: per image, the rectangles kept (see the class)."""
        torch = self.torch
        inputs = self.det_proc(images=pils, text=[self.text] * len(pils), return_tensors="pt").to(self.device)
        with torch.no_grad(), self.autocast():
            out = self.det(**inputs)
        out.logits, out.pred_boxes = out.logits.float(), out.pred_boxes.float()
        sizes = [p.size[::-1] for p in pils]
        try:
            res = self.det_proc.post_process_grounded_object_detection(
                out, inputs["input_ids"], box_threshold=self.box_threshold, text_threshold=self.text_threshold,
                target_sizes=sizes)
        except TypeError:                                   # newer transformers: threshold instead of box_threshold
            res = self.det_proc.post_process_grounded_object_detection(
                out, inputs["input_ids"], threshold=self.box_threshold, text_threshold=self.text_threshold,
                target_sizes=sizes)
        keep_all = []
        for pil, r in zip(pils, res):
            W, H = pil.size
            keep = []
            for b in r["boxes"].float().cpu().numpy():
                x0, y0, x1, y1 = b
                w, h = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
                if w <= 2 or h <= 2 or w * h > self.max_area * W * H or w > self.max_aspect * h:
                    continue
                keep.append([float(x0), float(y0), float(x1), float(y1)])
            keep_all.append(keep)
        return keep_all

    def __call__(self, bgr):
        return self.many([bgr])[0]

    def many(self, bgrs):
        """[(mask, rectangles, labels)] of several frames: one batch through Grounding DINO, one through the
        image encoder of SAM (the heavy part), then the boxes of every frame through the light mask decoder."""
        if not bgrs:
            return []
        try:
            return self._many(bgrs)
        except RuntimeError as e:
            if not self.half:
                raise
            print(f"segmentation in half precision failed ({e}): full precision from now on", flush=True)
            self.half = False
            return self._many(bgrs)

    def _many(self, bgrs):
        from PIL import Image
        torch = self.torch
        pils = [Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(b, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)) for b in bgrs]
        rects_all = self.rectangles_many(pils)
        todo = [i for i, r in enumerate(rects_all) if r]
        per_box_all = {}
        if todo:
            inputs = self.sam_proc(images=[pils[i] for i in todo], return_tensors="pt")
            pixels = inputs["pixel_values"].to(self.device)
            with torch.no_grad(), self.autocast():
                emb = self.sam.get_image_embeddings(pixels)
            for n, i in enumerate(todo):
                H, W = bgrs[i].shape[:2]
                rh, rw = [int(v) for v in inputs["reshaped_input_sizes"][n]]
                sx, sy = rw / W, rh / H                     # the box corners in the resized image (as SamProcessor)
                boxes = torch.tensor([[[x0 * sx, y0 * sy, x1 * sx, y1 * sy] for x0, y0, x1, y1 in rects_all[i]]],
                                     dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
                with torch.no_grad(), self.autocast():
                    out = self.sam(image_embeddings=emb[n:n + 1], input_boxes=boxes, multimask_output=False)
                masks = self.sam_proc.image_processor.post_process_masks(
                    out.pred_masks.float().cpu(), torch.tensor([[H, W]]), torch.tensor([[rh, rw]]))[0]
                per_box_all[i] = masks.numpy().reshape(len(rects_all[i]), H, W)
        results = []
        for i, bgr in enumerate(bgrs):
            H, W = bgr.shape[:2]
            mask = np.zeros((H, W), np.uint8)
            labels = np.zeros((H, W), np.uint8)             # 0 = background, k = box k (see real.py)
            if i in per_box_all:
                per_box = per_box_all[i]
                mask = (per_box.any(0) * 255).astype(np.uint8)
                # one label per box; where two masks overlap the smaller one wins: an overlap is mostly the
                # mask of one box spilling onto the box next to it, and the smaller mask is the tighter one
                for k in np.argsort([-m.sum() for m in per_box]):
                    labels[per_box[k]] = k + 1
            if self.gripper is not None:
                g = cv2.resize(self.gripper, (W, H)) > 127
                mask[g] = 0
                labels[g] = 0
            results.append((mask, rects_all[i], labels))
        return results


def overlay(bgr, mask, rects=(), labels=None):
    """The frame darkened outside the mask, mask contours in green (with labels: the contour of every box
    in its own colour), detector rectangles in red."""
    out = (bgr * 0.35).astype(np.uint8)
    out[mask > 0] = bgr[mask > 0]
    if labels is None:
        cnts, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
        cv2.drawContours(out, cnts, -1, (0, 255, 0), 2)
    else:
        colours = [(0, 255, 0), (255, 255, 0), (0, 255, 255), (255, 0, 255), (255, 128, 0), (0, 128, 255)]
        for k in range(1, int(labels.max()) + 1):
            cnts, _ = cv2.findContours((labels == k).astype(np.uint8), cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,
                                       cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
            cv2.drawContours(out, cnts, -1, colours[(k - 1) % len(colours)], 2)
    for x0, y0, x1, y1 in rects:
        cv2.rectangle(out, (int(x0), int(y0)), (int(x1), int(y1)), (0, 0, 255), 2)
    return out

==> ./bevnet/finetune.py <==
"""Fine-tuning of a simulation-trained image network on the real frames, leave-one-layout-out.

For each of the 8 real layouts: start from the simulation model (--init), train on the real scenes of the other
7 layouts (all readings, --epochs, small learning rate, colour jitter), optionally mixed with --sim-scenes
simulated scenes so it does not forget the simulation, choose the detection threshold on those training scenes,
and test on the scenes of the held-out layout. The same held-out scenes are also scored with the simulation
model as it is (zero-shot). No scene of a layout is ever used to train the model that is tested on it.

Outputs in --out: folds.csv (per layout: scenes, zero-shot and fine-tuned correct %, threshold),
test_scenes.csv (per held-out scene and reading), summary.csv.

    python -m bevnet.finetune --init results/bev_obst/bev_c64_m16 --real "data/bev_real/real_k*" --out results/bev_real_ft/
    python -m bevnet.finetune ... --sim data/bev_obst/train --sim-scenes 500
    python -m bevnet.finetune ... --layouts L10,L11          # only these folds; the others in folds.csv are kept
"""

import argparse
import csv
import glob
import json
import os
import time

import numpy as np
import torch

from bevnet import geometry as geo
from bevnet.data import BevDataset, collate
from bevnet.model import BevNet, losses
from bevnet.train import THRESHOLDS, predict, score, to, write_csv


def make_loader(ds, batch, shuffle, workers):
    return torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=batch, shuffle=shuffle, num_workers=workers,
                                       collate_fn=collate, persistent_workers=False)


def train_fold(model, train_ds, a, device):
    dl = make_loader(train_ds, a.batch, True, a.workers)
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=a.lr, weight_decay=1e-4)
    sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, T_max=a.epochs * len(dl))
    for epoch in range(a.epochs):
        model.train()
        for b in dl:
            b = to(b, device)
            img = b["images"]
            n = img.shape[0]
            gain = 1 + a.jitter * (torch.rand(n, 3, 1, 1, device=device) - 0.5)       # colour and brightness
            bias = 0.5 * a.jitter * (torch.rand(n, 1, 1, 1, device=device) - 0.5)
            img = (img * gain + bias).clamp(0, 1)
            heat, off = model(img, b["grids"], b["valid"], b["view"], b["scene"], b["n_scenes"])
            focal, l1 = losses(heat.float(), off.float(), b["heat"], b["off"], b["mask"])
            loss = focal + l1
            opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss.backward()
            opt.step()
            sched.step()


def best_threshold(model, ds, a, device):
    preds = predict(model, make_loader(ds, a.batch, False, a.workers), device)
    rates = {t: np.mean([r["correct"] for r in score(preds, t)]) for t in THRESHOLDS}
    return float(max(rates, key=rates.get))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--init", required=True, help="variant folder of bevnet.train (model.pt, variant.json)")
    ap.add_argument("--real", nargs="+", default=["data/bev_real/real_k*"])
    ap.add_argument("--sim", nargs="*", default=[], help="simulated set folders mixed into every fold's training")
    ap.add_argument("--sim-scenes", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="results/bev_real_ft/")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=2e-4)
    ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--jitter", type=float, default=0.3)
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=0, help="loader processes (0: macOS runs out of open files)")
    ap.add_argument("--device", default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--layouts", default=None, help="only these held-out layouts, e.g. L4,L9")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    torch.multiprocessing.set_sharing_strategy("file_system")
    device = torch.device(("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu") if a.device == "auto" else a.device)
    with open(os.path.join(a.init, "variant.json")) as f:
        v = json.load(f)
    state = torch.load(os.path.join(a.init, "model.pt"), map_location="cpu")
    sim_threshold = v["threshold"]
    dirs = sorted({d for p in a.real for d in glob.glob(p) if os.path.isdir(d)})
    real = BevDataset(dirs)
    layout_of = np.array([real.scene(i)["run"].split("_")[0] for i in range(len(real))])
    sim = None
    if a.sim and a.sim_scenes:
        sim = BevDataset(sorted({d for p in a.sim for d in glob.glob(p)}), a.sim_scenes)
    layouts = sorted(set(layout_of), key=lambda s: int(s[1:]) if s[1:].isdigit() else s)
    if a.layouts:
        layouts = [l for l in layouts if l in a.layouts.split(",")]
    os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
    folds, rows = [], []                       # layouts done in an earlier call (--layouts) are kept
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(a.out, "folds.csv")):
        with open(os.path.join(a.out, "folds.csv"), newline="") as f:
            folds = [r for r in csv.DictReader(f) if r["layout"] not in layouts]
        with open(os.path.join(a.out, "test_scenes.csv"), newline="") as f:
            rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(f) if r["layout"] not in layouts]
    print(f"device {device}; {len(real)} real scenes ({len(dirs)} readings), layouts {', '.join(layouts)}"
          + (f"; + {len(sim)} simulated scenes per fold" if sim else ""), flush=True)
    for lay in layouts:
        t0 = time.time()
        torch.manual_seed(a.seed)
        test_idx = np.nonzero(layout_of == lay)[0].tolist()
        train_idx = np.nonzero(layout_of != lay)[0].tolist()
        test_ds = torch.utils.data.Subset(real, test_idx)
        train_real = torch.utils.data.Subset(real, train_idx)
        train_ds = torch.utils.data.ConcatDataset([train_real, sim]) if sim else train_real
        model = BevNet(v["channels"], v["message"], len(geo.HEIGHTS_M), v.get("encoder", "small"), pretrained=False).to(device)
        model.load_state_dict(state)
        zero = score(predict(model, make_loader(test_ds, a.batch, False, a.workers), device), sim_threshold)
        train_fold(model, train_ds, a, device)
        th = best_threshold(model, train_real, a, device)
        tuned = score(predict(model, make_loader(test_ds, a.batch, False, a.workers), device), th)
        for z, r in zip(zero, tuned):
            rows.append(dict(r, layout=lay, zero_shot_correct=z["correct"], zero_shot_n_est=z["n_est"]))
        folds.append(dict(layout=lay, scenes=len(test_idx), threshold=th,
                          zero_shot_correct_pct=round(100 * np.mean([z["correct"] for z in zero]), 2),
                          finetuned_correct_pct=round(100 * np.mean([r["correct"] for r in tuned]), 2),
                          finetuned_too_few_pct=round(100 * np.mean([r["dn"] < 0 for r in tuned]), 2),
                          finetuned_too_many_pct=round(100 * np.mean([r["dn"] > 0 for r in tuned]), 2),
                          finetuned_rmse_cm=round(100 * float(np.nanmean([r["rmse"] for r in tuned])), 2)))
        f = folds[-1]
        print(f"  {lay:4s} zero-shot {f['zero_shot_correct_pct']:5.1f}%   fine-tuned {f['finetuned_correct_pct']:5.1f}%  "
              f"(too few {f['finetuned_too_few_pct']:4.1f}%, too many {f['finetuned_too_many_pct']:4.1f}%, "
              f"RMSE {f['finetuned_rmse_cm']:.1f} cm, threshold {th:.2f})  ({time.time() - t0:.0f} s)", flush=True)
        write_csv(os.path.join(a.out, "folds.csv"), folds)
        write_csv(os.path.join(a.out, "test_scenes.csv"), rows)
    num = lambda r, k: float(r[k]) if r[k] not in ("", "nan") else np.nan
    summary = dict(scenes=len(rows), layouts=len({r["layout"] for r in rows}),
                   zero_shot_correct_pct=round(100 * np.mean([num(r, "zero_shot_correct") for r in rows]), 2),
                   finetuned_correct_pct=round(100 * np.mean([num(r, "correct") for r in rows]), 2),
                   finetuned_too_few_pct=round(100 * np.mean([num(r, "dn") < 0 for r in rows]), 2),
                   finetuned_too_many_pct=round(100 * np.mean([num(r, "dn") > 0 for r in rows]), 2),
                   finetuned_rmse_cm=round(100 * float(np.nanmean([num(r, "rmse") for r in rows])), 2),
                   init=a.init, sim_scenes=len(sim) if sim else 0, epochs=a.epochs, lr=a.lr)
    write_csv(os.path.join(a.out, "summary.csv"), [summary])
    print(f"all layouts: zero-shot {summary['zero_shot_correct_pct']:.1f}%, fine-tuned {summary['finetuned_correct_pct']:.1f}% "
          f"(RMSE {summary['finetuned_rmse_cm']:.1f} cm); written in {a.out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

==> ./bevnet/compare.py <==
"""Correct scenes of the image-based network next to MHT and the GNN, set by set (same scenes, same metric).

Each --method is NAME=summary.csv: a summary of bevnet/train.py, pipeline/plan_mht.py (the rows with H = --h,
order 0) or gnn/train_sim.py (the GNN rows, mean over seeds). Writes table_BEV.csv (one row per test set, one
column per method) and fig_BEV-1 (correct scenes per scenario level, circle and random).

    python -m bevnet.compare --method "MHT (measurements)=results/plan/M3/summary.csv" \
        "GNN (measurements)=results/plan/M4/gnn/detection_full_full_h2/summary.csv" \
        "MHT (images, ArUco)=results/imgsim/M3/summary.csv" \
        "GNN (images, ArUco)=results/plan/M4/gnn/detection_full_full_h2/summary_imgsim.csv" \
        "Image network=results/bev/bev_c64_m16/summary.csv" --out results/bev/
"""

import argparse
import csv
import os
import re

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

SCENARIOS = ("G0", "E3", "S1")


def read(path, h):
    out = {}
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            if "method" in r and r["method"] != "gnn":
                continue
            if "H" in r and (int(float(r["H"])) != h or int(float(r.get("order", 0))) != 0):
                continue
            out[r.get("set") or r.get("test")] = float(r["correct_pct"])
    return out


def level_key(name):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]\d)_\D*(\d*)", name)
    return (m.group(1), int(m.group(2) or 0)) if m else (name, 0)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--method", nargs="+", required=True, help="NAME=path/to/summary.csv")
    ap.add_argument("--h", type=int, default=100, help="MHT hypotheses (rows of plan_mht summaries)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="results/bev/")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    methods = {}
    for item in a.method:
        name, path = item.split("=", 1)
        methods[name] = read(path, a.h)
    sets = sorted({s for v in methods.values() for s in v if s.split("_")[0] in SCENARIOS},
                  key=lambda s: (level_key(s), s.endswith("random")))
    os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
    rows = [dict(set=s, **{m: methods[m].get(s, "") for m in methods}) for s in sets]
    with open(os.path.join(a.out, "table_BEV.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["set"] + list(methods))
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"{'set':22s}" + "".join(f"{m[:20]:>22s}" for m in methods))
    for r in rows:
        print(f"{r['set']:22s}" + "".join(f"{r[m]:22.1f}" if r[m] != "" else f"{'-':>22s}" for m in methods))

    scen = [s for s in SCENARIOS if any(x.startswith(s + "_") for x in sets)]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, len(scen), figsize=(4.2 * len(scen), 6.4), squeeze=False, sharey=True)
    for c, sid in enumerate(scen):
        for r, family in enumerate(("circle", "random")):
            ax = axes[r, c]
            levels = [s for s in sets if s.startswith(sid + "_") and s.endswith(family)]
            labels = [s[len(sid) + 1:-len(family) - 1] for s in levels]
            for m in methods:
                xs = [k for k, s in enumerate(levels) if s in methods[m]]
                ax.plot(xs, [methods[m][levels[k]] for k in xs], "o-", label=m)
            ax.set_xticks(range(len(levels)), labels)
            ax.set_title(f"{sid}, {family}")
            ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
            ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
            if c == 0:
                ax.set_ylabel("correct scenes [%]")
    axes[0, 0].legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("png", "pdf"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(a.out, f"fig_BEV-1.{ext}"), dpi=150)
    print(f"written in {a.out}: table_BEV.csv, fig_BEV-1")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

==> ./bevnet/data.py <==
"""Training and test data of the image-based network: the scenes of sim/plan.py rendered at low resolution.

Every scene of a set is drawn by sim.plan.plan_scene with the seed of sim/plan.py, so scene i of
data/bev/<set>/ is scene i of data/plan/<set>/ (and of data/imgsim/<set>/): the image-based network, MHT and
the GNN can be compared scene by scene. For each robot the camera image is rendered (imgsim/render.py) at
--scale of the real 1280 x 720 (0.2 -> 256 x 144) and stored as JPEG, with the camera pose, pitch and roll.
Nothing else is kept from the renderer: the network gets the images and the poses.

Shards of SHARD scenes: data/bev/<set>/shard_<k>.pkl (a list of scenes), plus meta.json (camera matrix and
distortion at the rendered size, image size, appearance). Loading (BevDataset) decodes the images and
computes, from the poses, where each floor cell falls in each image (bevnet/geometry.py).

    python -m bevnet.data --sets train,val,G0,E3,S1                # 50,000 + 2,000 + 16 x 1,000 scenes
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train --runs 2000 --out data/bev_small/
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train,val,G0,E3,S1 --no-markers --out data/bev_nomarkers/   # boxes without markers
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train,val --obstacles 2 --out data/bev_obst/   # training scenes with the E3 cylinders
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train,val --obstacles 2 --distractors 4 --obstacle-style random \
        --obstacle-shapes cylinder,box,prism --out data/bev_rand/      # obstacles of random shape, colour, pattern
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train --runs 20000 --obstacles 2 --masks --out data/bev_mask2/   # box silhouettes
    python -m bevnet.data --sets train --runs 20000 --obstacles 2 --cutout --out data/bev_cut/    # boxes cut out

--cutout: the full rendering (tape, marker, shading, camera effects) inside the box silhouette, black elsewhere,
as bevnet/real.py --cutout makes of the real frames with the segmentation masks. In the training set the
silhouette is made imperfect as a real segmentation is (noisy_mask, one draw per image): with edges grown, a
ring of floor or background is kept around the boxes.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import glob
import json
import math
import multiprocessing
import os
import pickle
import shutil
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, replace

import cv2
import numpy as np

from bevnet import geometry as geo

SHARD = 250
CALIB = dict(P0="config/checkerboard_calib_P0.json", P1="config/checkerboard_calib_P1.json")


def render_shard(task):
    """Renders the scenes of one shard (one worker process): every scene of sim.plan with its seed, one image
    per robot, encoded and stored with the camera poses, the pitch and the true boxes."""
    (name, spec_dict, runs, start, seed, out_path, model_path, calib, scale, app_path, quality, no_markers, obstacles,
     obstacle_style, obstacle_shapes, distractors, visual, masks, cutout) = task
    from imgsim.render import Appearance, Renderer
    from sim.model import SensorModel
    from sim.plan import PlanSpec, plan_scene, run_model
    spec = PlanSpec(**spec_dict)
    m = run_model(SensorModel.load(model_path), spec)
    app = Appearance.load(app_path)
    if no_markers:
        app.draw_markers = False
    app.obstacle_style = obstacle_style
    app.visual_style = visual
    app.mask_only = bool(masks)
    if obstacle_shapes:
        app.obstacle_shapes = list(obstacle_shapes)
    renderer = Renderer(calib, app, seed=seed, scale=scale)
    scenes = []
    for i in range(start, start + runs):
        scene_seed = seed * 1_000_003 + i                       # the seed of sim/plan.py for this scene
        rng = np.random.default_rng(scene_seed)
        family = spec.families[i % len(spec.families)]
        spec_i = spec
        if obstacles:                                           # occluding cylinders as in E3, h drawn per scene
            h = int(np.random.default_rng(scene_seed + 104_729).integers(0, obstacles + 1))
            spec_i = replace(spec, hidden_robots=h)
        scene, meta = plan_scene(spec_i, family, rng, name, f"{name}_{i:05d}", m)
        if distractors:
            add_distractors(scene, distractors, np.random.default_rng(scene_seed + 15_485_863))
        rrng = np.random.default_rng(scene_seed + 7_919)        # as imgsim/generate.py
        style = renderer.scene_style(rrng)
        jpgs, poses, pitch, roll, seen_px = [], [], [], [], []
        for k, cap in enumerate(scene.captures):
            same = copy.deepcopy(rrng) if cutout else None       # the silhouette: same pitch and roll
            img, _markers, info = renderer.render(scene, k, rrng, style)
            if cutout:
                app.mask_only = True
                sil, _m, sil_info = renderer.render(scene, k, same, style)
                app.mask_only = False
                if name == "train":
                    sil = noisy_mask(sil, np.random.default_rng(scene_seed + 31 * (k + 1)), 1.0)
                img = np.where(sil[..., :1] > 127, img, 0).astype(np.uint8)
                info["box_pixels"] = sil_info["box_pixels"]
            if masks and app.marker_channel:                    # mask, markers, mask (B, G, R)
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".png", img)
            elif masks:                                         # binary: lossless and small
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".png", img[..., 0])
            else:
                ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".jpg", img, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, quality])
            jpgs.append(buf.tobytes())
            poses.append(cap.pose)
            pitch.append(np.radians(info["pitch_deg"]))
            roll.append(np.radians(info["roll_deg"]))
            if "box_pixels" in info:
                seen_px.append(info["box_pixels"])
        extra = dict(box_pixels=np.asarray(seen_px, np.int32)) if seen_px else {}
        scenes.append(dict(**extra, run=scene.run_id, family=family, boxes=np.asarray(scene.boxes, np.float32),
                           poses=np.asarray(poses, np.float32), pitch=np.asarray(pitch, np.float32),
                           roll=np.asarray(roll, np.float32), height=float(renderer.app.camera_height_m),
                           camera=os.path.basename(calib).split("_")[-1].split(".")[0], jpgs=jpgs,
                           n_robots=meta["n_robots"], n_boxes=meta["n_boxes"]))
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(scenes, f, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)
    return name, out_path


def add_distractors(scene, n_max, rng, tries=200):
    """0..n_max free-standing objects (footprint radius 6-20 cm) anywhere within 2 m of the centre, clear of
    the boxes, the robots and the other obstacles: things in the room that are not boxes."""
    from sim.plan import cylinder
    taken = [(np.asarray(b, float), 0.35) for b in scene.boxes] + \
            [(np.asarray(c.pose[:2], float), 0.30) for c in scene.captures] + \
            [(np.asarray(p, float).mean(0), float(np.max(np.hypot(*(np.asarray(p) - np.asarray(p).mean(0)).T))))
             for p in scene.obstacles]
    for _ in range(int(rng.integers(0, n_max + 1))):
